Vowel duration with speakers and words

Source: R/data.R
vowel_duration.Rd

16 speakers each produce the same 24 words, 12 with a voiceless and 12 with a voiced final consonant. Speakers differ in speed and in the size of their voicing effect; words differ in duration.

Usage

vowel_duration

Format

A tibble with 384 rows and 4 columns:

speaker

Speaker ID, S01 to S16.

word

Word ID, w01 to w24.

voicing

"voiceless" or "voiced".

duration

Vowel duration in ms.

Source

data-raw/vowel_duration.R

Details

True model: duration = 150 + s0 + w0 + (20 + s1) * voiced + e. By-speaker intercepts s0 have SD 25 ms and slopes s1 SD 12 ms (uncorrelated); by-word intercepts w0 have SD 15 ms; residual SD 20 ms.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("lme4", quietly = TRUE)) {
  m <- lme4::lmer(duration ~ voicing + (1 + voicing | speaker) + (1 | word),
                  data = vowel_duration)
  summary(m)
}
